findings: Structural: snapshot's deep daily history (2019-2024) belongs to then-deferred strip legs (deliveries 2025-10..2028-02); contemporaneous fronts are absent (expired-secdef wall). True front chain exists only 2025-08-01..2026-10-01 (n=281 daily returns). Deep-window stats are labeled curve-proxy, never tradable front.

Data-lane declared roll rule ('last session before day-1 of expiry month') is INFEASIBLE for NG as written: front's final trade is the 3rd-last business day of the PRIOR month, so the binding constraint is the contract's own last trade; implemented chain rolls at the outgoing final bar (13 matured rolls observed).

Liquidity migration is heterogeneous (13 matured pairs): 8/13 next-delivery volume crossover >=84 days before outgoing final (winter months dominate early), 5/13 no crossover within 90d, latest cycle (NGV26->NGX26) 6 days. Calendar-nearest != volume-max contract for NG; PIT selection rule materially matters.

Front-era descriptives (2025-08-01..2026-10-01): ann vol 49.2% (iid), 26.7% of days |r|>3%, 8.2% >5%, max |r| 18.1%; trailing-20d vol at snapshot 48.7%; winter |r| ~1.7x summer; lag-1 autocorr +0.10 (descriptive). Current sample is a HIGH-vol regime (2025-26 nearest-listed-chain vol 2-4x the 2020-24 level).

RTH intraday (H1 pooled 2025-07-21..2026-10-01, 291 days, 09:30-17:00 ET only): volume peaks in 10:00 (19.3%) and 14:00 (20.1%) hour buckets; Thursday 10:00 bucket holds 25.3% of day volume vs 16-18% other weekdays (contains EIA 10:30 release) - time-of-day descriptive, not an event study. M1: first-30-min 11.7% vs last-30-min 1.3% of RTH volume.

Curve: front-era m1-m2 median -0.112 USD/MMBtu, 75.2% days backwardated; strong monthly seasonality (Sep -0.44 contango vs Dec +0.55 backwardation, single cycle). Roll same-day calendar spread median +0.028 (30.8% negative).
